name: SG Micro Corp
summary: SG Micro Corp engages in the development, manufacturing and sales of comprehensive analog and mixed-signal integrated-circuit (IC) solutions in Mainland China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and internationally. Its products include signal chain ICs, power management ICs and sensor. The company offers operational, instrumentation, current-sense, and differential amplifiers, as well as application-specific and comparators; digital-to-analog and analog-to-digital converters, and AFE; series voltage and shunt voltage references; audio amplifiers, click-pop suppressors, audio line drivers, audio converters, and video buffers; and logic gates, specialty logic ICs, buffers, drivers, transceivers, flip-flops, …
